title: Doctor can crash before malformed object diagnostics
description: Evidence: object-store accepts any JSON object during section reads, InMemoryBorealStore dereferences record.meta.id, and doctor has no local catch around context.store.read while constructing object-v1 state. Impact: a malformed object such as {} can crash doctor before it reports shape diagnostics.
acceptanceCriteria: Doctor reports malformed object records as diagnostics instead of throwing during state construction, with a bad-object fixture.
